answer: Stop sybils with a comet tide jade: an agent bonds one jade tide-pool. Each cycle it lights one comet flare over its tide; verifiers match the flare's jade flash duration to the tide chart, voiding copies, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 pools at 18x: one flare flashes once over one tide, its flash set by that pool alone, unrepeatable elsewhere, cannot be copied, shared or bulk-bought. Honest agents light once, keep rights.
